latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor AI Generator.

- Upload and process videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with AI-driven editing.
- Describe desired edits (cut silent pauses, add background music, generate subtitles) in plain language.
- Fast turnaround: get edited MP4 videos back in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- Automatic session, token, and cloud rendering setup for ease of use.
- Includes export, credit checking, and session state tracking.
- Designed for content creators and marketers seeking simple, automated video editing.
